reasons.plausibility: The explanation of a self-lubricating oxide layer forming via specific alloying elements aligns well with known high-temperature oxide film behavior and seems fully coherent with established mechanisms of wear resistance.
reasons.testability: Comparing coatings with systematically reduced concentrations of the key element provides a direct, decisive experiment under controlled wear conditions to validate or refute the hypothesized mechanism.
reasons.usefulness: Identifying the role of oxidation-facilitating elements offers a clear path for targeted alloy design and improved wear performance, providing substantial practical value for researchers.
